evals.prompt: Bản vẽ AutoCAD đang mở, liệt kê các cột và dầm trên layer S-* và cho tôi biết cột nào lệch lưới.
evals.expected_output: Calls get_autocad_context first, then structural_detect_members (kinds column/beam, filter layers S-*) and structural_column_alignment_check with the same filter — not an ad-hoc execute_autocad_code script — reports members by handle with sizes in mm and the STR-ALN issues with locationMm, and pages with offset instead of raising maxCandidates when truncated.

assertions.text: get_autocad_context is called before any other AutoCAD tool
structural_detect_members and structural_column_alignment_check are used instead of an ad-hoc execute_autocad_code script
The same filter / ruleSet / tolerance is passed to both structural tools so ids agree
Members are reported by handle with sizes in mm; issues carry issueId, severity and locationMm

evals.prompt: Đổi tất cả text trên layer A-TEXT sang chiều cao 250 mm trong AutoCAD.
evals.expected_output: Checks the context (executionEnabled, isQuiescent), collects the handles with query_entities (filter types TEXT/MTEXT, layers A-TEXT, paging), runs update_entities_batch with handles + set {heightMm: 250} and dryRun: true first, shows the modifiedCount / rolledBack result and asks the user to confirm, then runs it without dryRun with a short label, and explains LAYER_LOCKED as a structured refusal (nothing written, atomic) if it appears.

assertions.text: Handles come from query_entities on this drawing, never guessed
update_entities_batch runs with dryRun: true first and the user is asked to confirm before the real run
The height is given in mm (heightMm), whatever INSUNITS is
A LAYER_LOCKED error is explained as a structured atomic refusal the user must unlock, not worked around

evals.prompt: Tool AutoCAD trả -32001 khi tôi gọi create_entities_batch, và trước đó bridge nói pipe hpautocad-mcp-2026 không có. Sửa sao?
evals.expected_output: Explains that -32001 means 'Allow AI code execution' is off in the HPAutoCad MCP Bridge window (ribbon HPAutoCad > MCP > MCP Bridge or HPMCPBRIDGE; it resets on every AutoCAD start), that a missing pipe means the bundle is not loaded or AutoCAD is closed (check the ApplicationPlugins bundle, SECURELOAD Always Load, the check-autocad-mcp.ps1 script), that the refusal is not a failed run and does not quarantine the tool, and does not suggest any bypass of the opt-in.

assertions.text: -32001 is identified as the execution opt-in being off in the bridge window
A missing pipe is diagnosed as bridge/bundle not loaded or AutoCAD closed, with the bundle folder and the health-check script named
No workaround that bypasses the opt-in (settings edit, automation) is suggested
